integrity: Exact rational finite checks supplement a proof from stationary product preservation, binomial two-step kernels, moment uniqueness, and explicit spin-correlation formulas. Independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The full partition factorization is for simultaneous independent parallel updates on bipartite graphs at positive reset rate. The Beta crossover requires both part sizes diverging. Weak convergence only; no finite-size rate, temporal independence, or historical-priority certification is claimed.
title: Exact partition independence and a double-Beta crossover in synchronous noisy voting
